meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 给选定的 NanoClaw agent 组注册 Tavily 远程 MCP 服务;装好后这些组多出 tavily_search 和 tavily_extract 两个工具,可做网页搜索和 URL 内容提取,且不需要 API key。
howto.when: 当你要在没有 API key 的情况下,为选定的 NanoClaw agent 组安装 Tavily 网页搜索或 URL 提取时触发。Claude 提供商以外的组、以及任何需要结构化提取的组受益最多。

say.text: 给 group-abc 这个组加上 Tavily 搜索和提取工具
say.note: 会先要求管理员批准再注册与重启该组

say.text: 帮我确认 group-abc 里的 Tavily 搜索能不能跑通
say.note: 用 max_results 1 试一次搜索并报告结果

say.text: keyless 额度用完了,帮我换成用 API key 的方式
say.note: agent 会引导通过 OneCLI 面板存入密钥并重新注册

howto.what_en: Registers Tavily's remote MCP server for selected NanoClaw agent groups, adding tavily_search and tavily_extract tools for web search and URL extraction with no API key.
howto.when_en: Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key into selected NanoClaw agent groups. Groups not on the Claude provider, and structured extraction anywhere, benefit most.

say_en.text: Add Tavily search and extract tools to the group group-abc
say_en.note: Admin approval is needed before registering and restarting

say_en.text: Check whether Tavily search works in group-abc
say_en.note: Runs one search with max_results 1 and reports

say_en.text: The keyless allowance ran out, switch me to an API key
say_en.note: Agent guides storing the key via the OneCLI dashboard
